title: 띄어쓰기 한눈에 보기: 어디를 붙이고 어디를 띄어요?
objective: By the end, you can use a short rule list to decide where to put spaces in everyday Korean sentences.
summary: A one-page guide to the main Korean spacing rules, with practice on real sentences.
note: These are the standard spacing rules (한글 맞춤법) used in schools, on forms, and in official writing.

task.title: Check and fix the spacing
task.line: Use the rule list and the four checking steps to choose, add, or correct the spaces in each sentence.

items.text: Write particles right after the word before them, with no space.
Write 이다 right after the noun, with no space.
In -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다, put a space before and after 수.
것 is its own word, even in its short forms 거 and 건.
In -(으)ㄴ 지 + a length of time, 지 stands alone.
때 is a noun, so put a space before it.
Put a space between a Korean number word and a counter. With digits, you may write them together (2잔).
Write 안 and 못 as separate words before the verb.
Write 씨 apart from the name.

sections.heading: Check your spacing in four steps

steps.en: Keep noun + 하다 verbs as one word.
Put a space before these small nouns.
Put spaces around counters, 안/못, and 씨.

sections.heading: Why spacing matters
paragraphs: Spacing can change the meaning. Koreans often joke about this: 아버지가 방에 들어가신다 (Father goes into the room) vs. 아버지 가방에 들어가신다 (Father goes into the bag).

Watch out: -는지 / -(으)ㄴ지 meaning 'whether' is an ending, so write it together: 어디 가는지 몰라요. 지 meaning 'time since' gets a space: 온 지 1년. In forms, emails, and résumés, correct spacing makes your writing look careful.

exercises: Choose the correctly spaced phrase: ① 김치를 (못 먹어요 / 못먹어요) ② 이 우산은 (언니 거예요 / 언니거예요) ③ 사과 (세 개 / 세개) 주세요.
Read the message and find the two spacing mistakes. Write the corrected forms: 수진씨, 내일 회의는 3시 예요. 바쁠 때는 안 와도 돼요.
Is the spacing correct? Write O or X: ① 어제 도서관에서 공부 했어요. ② 형이 어디 사는지 몰라요. ③ 배가 고플 때 라면을 먹어요. ④ 날씨가 추워서 밖에 안나가요.
answers: ① 못 먹어요 ② 언니 거예요 ③ 세 개
한국에 온 지 석 달 됐어요. (세 달 is also correct.)
① X (공부했어요) ② O ③ O ④ X (안 나가요)
